gaps.lead: Darius soon recovered after the operation on his knee and was able to rejoin the team.
gaps.sentence: After the operation on his knee, Darius ___ and was able to rejoin the team.
gaps.explanation: 'Recovered soon' is expressed with the noun: 'made a quick/fast/rapid recovery'.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
She prefers reading books to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.lead: People believe she was the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the finest pianist of her generation.
gaps.explanation: A present belief about a past event: is thought to have + participle.

gaps.lead: As I get older, I become less patient.
gaps.sentence: The older I get, ___ I become.
gaps.explanation: The older…, the more… — doubled comparatives for parallel change.

gaps.lead: My salary is half the size of my brother's.
gaps.explanation: 'Half the size of' reversed becomes 'twice as much as'.

gaps.lead: A professional will repair the roof next week.
gaps.explanation: 'Have something done' — arranged service: have the roof repaired.

gaps.lead: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for years.
gaps.sentence: It's ___ I've enjoyed myself so much.
gaps.explanation: It's (been) years since + past simple = I haven't done it for years.
